name: Book Search Plan
title: BOOK-101: book search by title or author
meta: Entry point: GET /books/search?q= (existing stub, called by the home page search box)
18 failing tests already exist in tests/routes/book-search.test.ts
No schema change, migration or new dependency. Nothing is committed until you approve
context: The home page search box already sends GET /books/search?q= with HTMX, but the route is a stub. This change makes it return the matching books as the same card grid the home page shows, matched on title or author as continuous text in any position, ignoring case (accented letters included), sorted by title. An empty, missing or whitespace-only query shows every book; a query over 100 characters after trimming, or a q sent twice or as an object, gets a 400 error fragment. The controller only reads q and picks the response, the new service holds the rules (type check, trim, length, empty means all), and the repository runs one parameterised query. SQLite folds ASCII letters only, so the database wrapper registers a small unicode_lower SQL function and the query uses instr() instead of LIKE, which also makes % and _ plain characters. The failing tests for every criterion already exist and are not changed.

children.name: GET /books/search
children.purpose: Replaces the stub. Passes req.query.q unchanged to bookService.searchBooks, renders books/book-grid with 200. Catches ValidationError and renders books/search-error with 400; any other error goes on to Express's error handler. No trimming or checks here.

files.purpose: Typed errors that services throw and controllers map to responses.

children.name: ValidationError
children.purpose: Error subclass with name 'ValidationError', exactly as in the layer rules.

files.purpose: Business rules for book search. No req/res, no status codes, no SQL.

children.name: searchBooks
children.purpose: Missing q counts as empty. A non-string q (array or object) throws ValidationError('Search query must be a single text value'). Trims; if more than 100 Unicode characters (Array.from length) throws ValidationError('Search query must be 100 characters or fewer'). Empty after trim returns getAllBooks(); otherwise returns the repository's searchBooks(trimmed). Inner spaces kept.

children.name: SEARCH_QUERY_MAX_LENGTH
children.purpose: 100, the limit on the trimmed query.

files.purpose: Data access for books. One query per function. getAllBooks is reused unchanged for the empty query.

children.name: searchBooks
children.purpose: Existing, unused LIKE helper rewritten: 'SELECT * FROM books WHERE instr(unicode_lower(title), unicode_lower(?)) > 0 OR instr(unicode_lower(author), unicode_lower(?)) > 0 ORDER BY title' with [text, text]. The text is only ever a bound value; instr has no wildcards, so % and _ are literal, and one row per book means a match in both fields appears once.

files.purpose: sql.js wrapper (initDb, all, get, run). No schema or data change.

children.name: initDb
children.purpose: After opening each Database, registers the SQL function unicode_lower with db.create_function: JavaScript toLowerCase on text, NULL stays NULL. Lives only on the open connection; nothing is written to the database file or schema.
